items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Nettie James, that was the guitar player.

ctx.x: He still plays a little bit, I think.
Yeah. Joe Gabriel, he was the violin player. And Nettie James, that was the guitar player. The fellow that played bass, he called him bourgeois.
What did you say? You used to call those James? What's his nickname? Dodoos. Dodoos?
